English: Outcomes of the study revealed; a wide distribution of Amblyomma hebraeum in all four studied sub-districts, gradual annual increase in heartwater cases in Moshupa sub-district and indication of increased impact on indigenous caprine species despite the effort to control vectors by 63% of interviewed farmers.
Luganda: Ebyava mu kunoonyereza byalaga nti; Amblyomma hebraeum yali asaasaanye nnyo mu disitulikiti zonna ennya ezaakolerwamu okunoonyereza, waaliwo okweyongeranga mu muwendo gw’ensolo ezirwala heartwater buli mwaka mu Moshupa sub-district n’okuba ng’ebika by’ensolo binnansangwa bye byasinga okukosebwa newankubadde nga waaliwo kaweefube w’okulwanyisa obuwuka mu bitundu 63% eby’abalunzi abaabuuzibwa.
Yoruba: Àbájáde iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí ti fi hàn pé; Amblyomma hebraeum pọ̀ ní àwọn ìhà-àgbègbè mẹ́rin tí wọ́n ṣe iṣẹ́ ìwádìí lé lórí, bí àwọn àìsàn tí àwọn ìdun náà ń fà sí ara àwọn ẹran náà lọ́ọ́dọdún ní ìhà-àgbègbè Moshupa àti ìtọ́kasí bí ipa rẹ̀ ṣe pọ̀ sí lórí àwọn ẹ̀yà ẹran ìsìn pẹ̀lú gbogbo akitiyan tí wọ́n ṣe láti ṣàkóso àwọn fẹ́kítọ̀ náà tí 63% àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí wọ́n fọ̀rọ̀ wá wọn lẹ́nu wò ṣe.
Zulu: Imiphumela yocwaningo idalule; ukusatshalaliswa okubanzi kwe-Amblyomma hebraeum kuzo zonke izigodi ezine ezicwaningiwe, ukwanda kancane kancane ngonyaka kwezifo zenhliziyo esifundeni sase-Moshupa kanye nenkomba yokwanda komthelela ezinhlotsheni zomdabu zezimbuzi naphezu komzamo wokulawula amagciwane ngama-63% abalimi okukhulunywe nabo.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken ya bayyana; faɗin rarraba Amblyomma hebraeum a cikin dukkanin gundumomi huɗu da aka yi nazari, sannu a hankali ƙaruwa a kowace shekara a cikin aukuwar cutar kumburin zuciya a cikin gundumar Moshupa da kuma nunin ƙaruwar tasiri a kan nau’in caprine na asali duk da ƙoƙarin shawo kan masu yaɗa cutar da kashi 63% na manoma da aka tattauna da su.

English: Amblyomma hebraeum, the principal vector of Ehrlichia ruminantium in Southern Africa is widely distributed in the Southern District of Botswana and thus poses a challenge to livestock productivity in this district and, perhaps, elsewhere in the country where the tick infests livestock.

Yoruba: Amblyomma Hebraeum, tí ó jẹ́ olórí fẹ́kítọ̀ tí Ehrlichia ruminantum ní Gúùsù Africa pọ̀ káàkiri àgbègbè Gúùsu Botswana, tí ó sì ń fa ìpalára fún ìbísi àwọn ẹran ní àgbègbè yìí, àti pé wọ́n tún lè wà ní àwọn ibi míràn ní orílẹ̀-èdè náà tí àwọn ìdun tí ń fa àìsàn sí àwọn ẹran náà lára.
Zulu: I-Amblyomma hebraeum, isinambuzane esilumayo esiyinhloko ye-Ehrlichia ruminantium eNingizimu ne-Afrika isatshalaliswa kabanzi esiFundeni esiseNingizimu ye-Botswana futhi ngaleyo ndlela ibeka inselele ekukhiqizeni kwemfuyo kulesi sifunda, mhlawumbe, nakwezinye izindawo ezweni lapho amakhizane ahlasela khona imfuyo.
Hausa: Amblyomma hebraeum, babban jigon Ehrlichia ruminantium a Kudancin Afirka yana yaɗuwa a yankin Kudancin ƙasar Botswana kuma don haka yana haifar da ƙalubale ga yawan amfanin dabbobi a wannan gundumar, kuma wataƙila, a wasu wurare a cikin ƙasar inda kaska take mamaye dabbobi.

English: This study reports on the widespread burden of ticks and heartwater disease in southern Botswana between 2017 and 2019.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwogera ku kizibu ekinene eky’enkwa n’obulwadde bwa heartwater mu bukiikaddyo bwa Botswana wakati wa 2017 ne 2019.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí jábọ̀ lórí wàhálà ìtànkálẹ̀ àwọn ìdun àti àìsàn tí wọ́n ń fà sí ara àwọn ẹran ìsìn ní gúùsù Botswana láàárín 2017 sí 2019.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lubika ngomthwalo osabalele wamakhizane nesifo senhliziyo eningizimu ye-Botswana phakathi kowezi-2017 nowezi-2019.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya bayar da rahoto a kan yawaitar kaska da cutar kumburin zuciya a kudancin Botswana a tsakanin shekarar 2017 da shekarar 2019.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di tšweletša mathata ao a bakwago ke dikgofa phatlalatša le bolwetši bja leruo ka borwa bja Botswana magareng ga 2017 le 2019.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በ2017 እና 2019 መካከል ተስፋፍቶ የነበረውን የመዥገሮች እና የልብ ውሃ በሽታ ጫናን ይዘግባል።

English: The results of the study could help the government and farmers make plans to better control heartwater disease.
Luganda: Ebyava mu kunoonyereza bisobola okuyamba gavumenti n’abalimi mu nteekateeka ez’okulwanyisa obulungi obulwadde bwa heartwater.
Yoruba: Àbájáde iṣé ìwádìí yìí lè ran ìjọba àti àwọn àgbẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ láti ṣètò tó tún péye láti ṣàkóso àwọn àìsàn tí ìdun ń fà sí ara àwọn ẹran ìsìn náà.
Zulu: Imiphumela yocwaningo ingasiza uhulumeni nabalimi ukuthi benze izinhlelo zokulawula kangcono isifo senhliziyo.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken zai iya taimaka wa gwamnati da manoma su tsara tsare-tsare domin magance cutar kumburin zuciya.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša dinyakišišo di ka thuša mmušo le balemi go loga maano a go laola bokaone bolwetši bja leruo.
Amharic: የጥናቱ ውጤት የልብ ውሃ በሽታን በተሻለ መንገድ ለመቆጣጠር እቅዶችን እንዲቀርጹ መንግስት እና ገበሬዎችን ሊረዳ ይችላል።

English: Certain ticks carry a bacteria called Ehrlichia ruminantium, which causes a disease known as heartwater in cattle, sheep and goats.
Luganda: Waliwo enkwa ezitambuza bakitiiriya eyitibwa Ehrlichia ruminantium, ereeta obulwadde obuyitibwa heartwater mu nte, endiga n’embuzi.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìdun kan tí ń gbé kòkòrò tí wọ́n ń pè ní Ehrlichia ruminantium, tí ń fa àìsàn tí a mọ̀ sí àwọn àìsàn tí ìdun ń fà sí ara àwọn ẹran, àgùntàn àti ewúrẹ́.
Zulu: Amanye amakhizane athwala igciwane elibizwa nge-Ehrlichia ruminantium, elidala isifo esaziwa ngokuthi yisifo senhliziyo ezinkomeni, ezimvini nasezimbuzini.
Hausa: Wasu kaska suna ɗauke da ƙwayar cuta mai suna Ehrlichia ruminantium, wadda take haifar da wata cuta da aka sani da cutar kumburin zuciya a cikin shanu fa tumaki da kuma awaki.
Northern Sotho: Tše dingwe tša dikgofa di phatlalatša dipaktheria tše di bitšwago Ehrlichia ruminantium, tšeo di tsebjago bjalo ka bolwetši bja leruo go dikgomo, dinku le dipudi.
Amharic: አንዳንድ መዥገሮች በከብቶች፣ በበጎች እና በፍየሎች መካከል የልብ ውሃ በሽታን የሚያስከትለውን እርሊቺያ ሩሚናንቲየም የተባለው ባክቴሪያ ተሸካሚ ናቸው።

English: This bacteria is a parasite, meaning that it feeds off other living organisms like livestock, causing them harm.
Luganda: Bakitiiriya eno eriira ku bintu ebirala ebiramu ng’ensolo, n’ebituusaako obulabe.
Yoruba: Kòkòrò náà jẹ́ kòkòrò ajẹnipa, ní èyí tó túmọ̀ sí pé ó ń jẹ láti ara àwọn nǹkan abẹ̀mí bíi àwọn ẹran ìsìn, tí ó sì ń fa ìpalára fún wọn.
Zulu: Leli gciwane liyinto ephila ngokudla emzimbeni wenye into, okusho ukuthi lidla ezinye izinto eziphilayo njengemfuyo, lizibangele ukulimala.
Hausa: Wannan ƙwayar cuta kaska ce, ma'ana tana cin abinci daga sauran halittu masu rai kamar dabbobi, kuma suna cutar da su.
Northern Sotho: Pakteria ye ke senwamadi, se se šupago gore e iphediša ka diphedi tše dingwe tše bjalo ka leruo, tša di kweša bohloko.
Amharic: ይህ ባክቴሪያ ጥገኛ ተህዋስ ነው፣ ማለትም እንደ ከብቶች ያሉትን ሌሎች በህይወት ያሉ ፍጡራን እየበላ ጉዳት ያደርስባቸዋል።

English: Livestock suffering with heartwater disease usually have a high body temperature, lose their appetite, have breathing problems, and may eventually die.
Luganda: Ensolo ezirina obulwadde bwa heartwater zitera okufuna ebbugumu ly’omubiri eringi, tezaagala kulya, obuzibu mu kussa, era ziyinza n’oluvannyuma okufa.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹran tí wọ́n bá ní àìsàn tí ìdun ń fà yìí máa ń sábà wà kí ara wọn máa lọ́, kí wọ́n má lè jẹun, kí wọ́n ní ìṣoro pẹ̀lú mímí dáadáa, àti pé wọ́n lè pàápàá kú.
Zulu: Imfuyo ehlushwa isifo senhliziyo ivamise ukuba nokushisa komzimba okuphezulu, ingakuthandi ukudla, ibe nezinkinga zokuphefumula, futhi ingase ife ekugcineni.
Hausa: Dabbobin da suke fama da cutar kumburin zuciya yawanci suna da zafin jiki mai yawa, suna rasa ci, suna samun matsalar numfashi, kuma suna iya mutuwa ma a ƙarshe.
Northern Sotho: Leruo leo le hlasetšwego ke bolwetši bja leruo gantši themphereitšha ya lona ya mmele e godimo, le lahlegelwa ke tatso, le itemogela mathata a go hema, ebile le ka feleletša le hwile.
Amharic: በልብ ውሃ በሽታ የሚሰቃዩ ከብቶች አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ከፍተኛ የሰውነት ሙቀት ይኖራቸዋል፣ የመመገብ ፍላጎታቸውንም ያጣሉ፣ እንዲሁም የመተንፈስ ችግር ያለባቸው ሲሆን ውሎ አድሮም ሊሞቱ ይችላሉ።

English: Heartwater is very common in the southern part of Botswana, and farmers in that area are losing their livestock to the disease.
Luganda: Obulwadde bwa heartwater busangibwa nnyo mu kitundu ky’obukiikaddyo bwa Botswana, era abalimi mu kitundu ekyo bafiirwa ebisolo byabwe olw’obulwadde buno.
Yoruba: Àìsàn tí ìdun ń fà sí àwọn ẹran ìsìn lára wọ́pọ̀ ní gúùsù Botswana, àti pé àwọn àgbẹ̀ tí wọ́n wà ní àgbègbè náà ń pàdánù àwọn ẹran wọn sí àìsàn náà.
Zulu: Isifo senhliziyo sivame kakhulu engxenyeni eseningizimu ye-Botswana, futhi abalimi kuleyo ndawo balahlekelwa imfuyo yabo ngenxa yalesi sifo.
Hausa: Cutar kumburin zuciya ta zama ruwan dare a kudancin ƙasar Botswana, kuma manoman yankin na asarar dabbobinsu sakamakon kamuwa da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Bolwetši bja leruo e tlwaelegile kudu ka tikologong ya borwa bja Botswana, gomme balemi ka tikologong yeo ba loba leruo la bona ka lebaka la bolwetši.
Amharic: በደቡባዊ የቦትስዋና ክፍል የልብ ውሃ በሽታ የተለመደ ሲሆን በዚያ አካባቢ ያሉ ገበሬዎች ከብቶቻቸውን በበሽታው እያጡ ነው።

English: In this study, researchers investigated the burden of heartwater in southern Botswana.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza beetegereza obulabe bwa heartwater mu bukiikaddyo bwa Botswana.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣé ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ìwádìí wàhálà àwọn àìsàn tí ìdun ń fà ní gúùsù Botsawana.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baphenye umthwalo wesifo senhliziyo eningizimu ye-Botswana.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun binciki yawaitar cutar kumburin zuciya a kudancin ƙasar Botswana.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba dirile diphatišišo ka mathata a go bakwa ke bolwetši bja leruo ka borwa bja Botswana.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች በደቡባዊ ቦትስዋና ያለውን የልብ ውሃ በሽታ ጫና መርምረዋል።

English: They first collected, counted and identified ticks from cattle, sheep and goats to compare the number of ticks carrying the heartwater parasite to other ticks.
Luganda: Basooka kukuŋŋaanya, ne babala era ne bamanya enkwa okuva ku nte, endiga n’embuzi okugeraageranya enkwa ezitambuza obuwuka bwa heartwater n’enkwa endala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n kọ́kọ́ gbà, kà àti dá àwọn ìdun tí wọ́n gbà látara ẹran, àgùntàn àti ewúrẹ́ mọ̀ láti ṣe àfiwéra iye àwọn ìdun tí ń gbé àwọn àìsàn tí ó ń mú àwọn ẹran náà sí àwọn ìdun tó kù.
Zulu: Baqale baqoqa, babala futhi bakhomba amakhizane ezinkomeni, ezimvini nasezimbuzini ukuze baqhathanise inani lamakhizane athwala amagciwane esifo senhliziyo kwamanye amakhizane.
Hausa: Da farko sun tattara da ƙirga da kuma gano kaska daga shanu da tumaki da awaki don kwatanta adadin kaska da suke ɗauke da ciwon kumburin zuciya da sauran kaska.
Northern Sotho: Ba thomile pele ka go kgoboketša, ba bala le go hlaola dikgofa dikgomong, dinkung le dipuding go bapetša palo ya dikgofa tšeo di phatlalatšago dinwamadi tša bolwetši bja leruo le dikgofa tše dingwe.
Amharic: በመጀመሪያ የልብ ውሃ ጥገኛ ተህዋስን ተሸካሚ የሆኑት መዥገሮች ቁጥር ከሌሎች መዥገሮች ጋር ለማነጻጸር ከከብቶች፣ ከበጎች እና ከፍየሎች መዥገሮችን ሰብስበዋል፣ ቆጥረዋል እንዲሁም ለይተዋል።

English: The researchers also interviewed some farmers on their experiences with heartwater, and collected some heartwater reports from the veterinary (animal health) office.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baabuuza abamu ku balunzi ku bye bayiseemu ne heartwater, era ne bakuŋŋaanyaayo ne ku alipoota ku heartwater okuva mu woofiisi y’ebyebisolo (ebyobulamu bw’ebisolo).
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún ṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò fún àwọn àgbẹ̀ kan lórí ìrírí wọn pẹ̀lú àìsàn tí ìdun ń fà, tí wọ́n sì gba àwọn àkọsílẹ̀ kan lórí àwọn àìsàn tí ìdun ń fà lọ́wọ́ ọ́fíìsì àwọn oníṣèwòsàn ẹranko (ìlera àwọn ẹranko).
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde baxoxisana nabanye abalimi mayelana nolwazi lwabo ngesifo senhliziyo, futhi baqoqa imibiko yesifo senhliziyo evela ehhovisi lezilwane (impilo yezilwane).
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma yi hira da wasu manoma a kan abubuwan da suka samu game da cutar kumburin zuciya, kuma sun tattara wasu rahotannin cutar kumburin zuciya daga ofishin kula da dabbobi (lafiyar dabbobi).
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba swere le dipoledišano le balemi ba bangwe go kwa maitemogelo a bona ka bolwetši bja leruo, ba hwetša tše dingwe tša dipego tša bolwetši bja leruo go tšwa ofising ya dingaka tša diphoofolo (kalafo ya diphoofolo).
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ አንዳንድ ገበሬዎች ስለ ልብ ውሃ በሽታ ስላላቸው ልምምድ ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገውላቸዋል፤ እንዲሁም ከእንስሳት ሃኪም ቤት (የእንስሳት ጤና) ቢሮ በልብ ውሃ ላይ የተጻፉ ዘገባዎችን አሰባስበዋል።

English: The researchers said the harmful ticks were widespread in the study area, and that the number of heartwater disease cases increased from one year to the next.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti enkwa ez’obulabe zaali zisangibwa wangi mu kitundu ekinoonyerezebwamu, era nti omuwendo gw’ensolo ezirina heartwater gwali gulinnya buli mwaka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn ìdun tí ń fa ìpalára púpọ̀ pọ̀ gan ní àgbègbè tí wọ́n ti ṣe iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà, àti pé iye àwọn ẹran tí wọ́n ń ní àìsàn tí àwọn ẹran ń ní látara ìdun ń pọ̀ si lọ́ọ́dọdún.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe amakhizane ayingozi ayesabalele endaweni yocwaningo, kanti isibalo sesifo senhliziyo senyuka sisuka komunye unyaka siya komunye.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce kaska masu cutarwa sun yaɗu a wurin binciken, kuma adadin masu kamuwa da cutar kumburin zuciya yana ƙaruwa daga shekara guda zuwa gaba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dikgofa tše kotsi di be di phatlaletše ka tikologong ya dinyakišišo, le gore palo ya malwetši a leruo e hlatlogile ngwaga ka ngwaga.
Amharic: ጥናቱ በተካሄደበት አካባቢ ጎጂዎቹ መዥገሮች ተስፋፍተው የነበረ ሲሆን የልብ ውሃ በሽታ ቁጥርም ከአመት ወደ አመት እየጨመረ መሄዱን ተመራማሪዎቹ ይናገራሉ።

English: They collected 310 ticks between 2017 and 2019.
Luganda: Baakuŋŋaanya enkwa 310 wakati wa 2017 ne 2019.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gba ìdun 310 láàárín 2017 sí 2019.
Zulu: Baqoqe amakhizane angama-310 phakathi kowezi-2017 nowezi-2019.
Hausa: Sun tattara kaskoki guda 310 a tsakanin shekarar 2017 da kuma shekarar 2019.
Northern Sotho: Ba kgobokeditše dikgofa tše 310 magareng ga 2017 le 2019.
Amharic: በ2017 እና 2019 መካከል 310 መዥገሮች ሰብስበዋል።

English: They found 3 types of ticks: the South African bont tick, the bont-legged tick, and the brown dog tick.
Luganda: Baazuula ebika by’enkwa 3: South African bont tick, bont-legged tick, ne brown dog tick.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí irúfẹ́ ìdun 3:Irúfẹ́ àwọn ìdun tí wọ́n jẹ mọ́ South Africa, àwọn ìdun dúdú ẹlẹ́sẹ̀ gígùn àti eégbọn.
Zulu: Bathola izinhlobo ezi-3 zamakhizane: amakhizane aseNingizimu Afrika, ikhizane elinemilenze emide, kanye nekhizane lenja elinsundu.
Hausa: Sun sami nau’o’in kaska guda 3: kaska ta Afirka ta Kudu, kaska mai lanƙwasasshiyar ƙafa, da kuma kaska launin kare mai ruwan ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše mehuta ye 3 ya dikgofa: Patšane ya go ngaparela ya ka Afrika Borwa, kgofa ya maoto a go ngaparela, le kgofa ye tshotho e hwetšwago dimpšeng.
Amharic: 3 አይነት መዥገሮችን አግኝተዋል፡- የደቡብ አፍሪካው ቦንት መዥገር፣ የቦንት እግር ያለው መዥገር እና ቡናማ ውሻ መዥገር፡፡

English: The most common was the South African bont tick (85%), and this is the one that carries the bacteria that causes heartwater disease.
Luganda: Eyasinga okusangibwa yali South African bont tick (85%), era eno y’etambuza bakitiiriya erwaza obulwadde bwa heartwater.
Yoruba: Èyí tó wọ́pọ̀ jù ni àwọn ìdun tó jẹ mọ́ South Africa (85%), ní èyí tó jẹ́ pé òun ló ń gbé kòkòrò tí ó ń fa àwọn àìsàn tí ó ń mú àwọn ẹran tí ìdun ń fà.
Zulu: Evame kakhulu kwakuyikhizane laseNingizimu Afrika (85%), futhi ilona eliphethe amagciwane abangela isifo senhliziyo.
Hausa: Wadda ta fi zama gama-gari ita ce bont tick ta Afirka ta Kudu (85%), kuma wannan ita ce take ɗauke da ƙwayoyin cutar da suke haifar da cutar kumburin zuciya.
Northern Sotho: Kgofa ye e bego e tlwaelegile kudu e bile patšane ya go ngaparela ya ka Afrika Borwa (85%), gomme ye ke kgofa ye phatlalatšago paktheria ye e bakago bolwetši bja leruo.
Amharic: (85%) የሚሆነው በጣም የተለመደው የደቡብ አፍሪካው ቦንት መዥገር ሲሆን ይህም የልብ ውሃ በሽታ አምጪ የሆነውን ባክቴሪያ የሚሸከመው ነው።

English: The other 2 types of tick they identified do not contribute to heartwater disease, but are linked to other livestock diseases like ‘theileriosis’, ‘anaplasmosis’ and ‘babesiosis’.
Luganda: Ebikwa by’enkwa ebirala 2 bye baazuula tebiviirako bulwadde bwa heartwater, naye nga zirina akakwate ku bulwadde bw’ensolo obulala nga ‘theileriosis’, ‘anaplasmosis’ ne ‘babesiosis’.
Yoruba: Àwọn irúfẹ́ ìdun 2 tó kù tí wọ́n dámọ̀ kìí fa àwọn àìsàn ti ìdun yìí ń fà fún àwọn ẹran ìsìn náà, ṣùgbọ́n tí wọ́n tan mọ́ àwọn àìsàn míràn tí ń mú ẹran bíi ‘theileriosis’, ‘anaplasmosis’ àti ‘babesiosis’.
Zulu: Ezinye izinhlobo ezi-2 zamakhizane abazihlonzile azithinteki esifweni senhliziyo, kodwa zixhunyaniswa nezinye izifo zemfuyo njenge ‘theileriosis’, ‘anaplasmosis’ kanye ne ‘babesiosis’.
Hausa: Sauran nau’o’in kaska guda 2 da aka gano ba sa taimakawa ga cutar kumburin zuciya, amma suna da alaƙa da wasu cututtukan dabbobi kamar 'cutar cizon kaska mai sa zazzaɓi mai zafi da ƙarancin jini', 'cutar cizon kaska mai sa yawan zafin jiki da tsoka mai raɗaɗi ' da kuma 'cutar cizon kaska mai sa yawan zafin jiki da tari da kuma fitsari mai duhu '.
Northern Sotho: Mehuta ye mengwe ye 2 ya dikgofa yeo ba e lemogilego ga e na bake bolwetši bja leruo, eupša e amantšhwa le malwetši a mangwe go leruo a bjalo ka ‘theileriosis’, ‘anaplasmosis’ le ‘babesiosis’.
Amharic: ሌሎቹ 2 አይነት መዥገሮች የልብ ውሃ በሽታን ለማምጣት ምንም ድርሻ የላቸውም፣ ሆኖም ግን እንደ ‘ቲለሪዮሲስ’፣ ‘አናፕላስሞሲስ’ እና ‘ቤብሲዮሲስ’ ከተባሉ ከሌሎች የከብት በሽታዎች ጋር የተዛመዱ ናቸው።

English: The area that the researchers studied covered Goodhope, Kanye, Moshupa, and Jwaneng.
Luganda: Ekitundu abanoonyereza kye beetegereza mwalimu Goodhope, Kanye, Moshupa, ne Jwaneng.
Yoruba: Àwọn àgbègbè tí àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ìwádìí lé lórí ni Goodhope, Kanye, Moshupa àti Jwaneng.
Zulu: Indawo abacwaningi abayicwaningile ihlanganise i-Goodhope, Kanye, Moshupa, kanye no-Jwaneng.
Hausa: Yankin da masu binciken suka yi nazari sun shafi Goodhope da Kanye da Moshupa da kuma Jwaneng.
Northern Sotho: Tikologo yeo banyakišiši ba dirilego diphatišišo go yona e be e akaretša Goodhope, Kanye, Moshupa, le Jwaneng.
Amharic: የተመራማሪዎቹ ጥናት የሸፈናቸው አካባቢዎች ጉድሆፕ፣ ካንዬ፣ ሞሹፓ፣ እና ጅዋኔንግ ናቸው።

English: Ticks were more abundant in Goodhope, Kanye and Moshupa.
Luganda: Enkwa zaali zisinga kusangibwa mu Goodhope, Kanye ne Moshupa.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìdun náà pọ̀ gan ní Goodhope, Kanye àti Moshupa.
Zulu: Amakhizane abegcwele e-Goodhope, Kanye nase-Moshupa.
Hausa: Ticks sun fi yawa a cikin Goodhope, Kanye da Moshupa.
Northern Sotho: Dikgofa di be di atile kudu go la Goodhope, Kanye le Moshupa.
Amharic: በጉድሆፕ፣ በካንዬ፣ እና በሞሹፓ እጅግ ብዙ መዥገሮች ነበሩ።

English: These areas were mostly moist, rocky and had more vegetation.
Luganda: Ebitundu bino byalimu nnyo enkuba, amayinja era byalimu n’omuddo mungiko.
Yoruba: Àwọn àgbègbè yìí tutù, wọ́n ní àpáta àti ewéko púpọ̀.
Zulu: Lezi zindawo zazinomswakama kakhulu, zinamatshe futhi zinezitshalo eziningi.
Hausa: Waɗannan wuraren galibi suna da laima, dutse kuma suna da ciyayi da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Ditikologo tše di be di na le monola a montši, di na le maswika le sethokgwa se sentši.
Amharic: እነዚህ አካባቢዎች በአብዛኛው እርጥብ፣ ድንጋያማ እና ብዙ እጽዋት ያሏቸው ናቸው።

English: Jwaneng, which had the least number of ticks, was rather dry, sandy and had less vegetation.
Luganda: Jwaneng, ekyalimu omuwendo gw’enkwa ogusinga obutono, kyali kikaluko, kya musenyu era nga n’omuddo mutono.
Yoruba: Jwaneng, tí ò ní àwọn ìdun tó pọ̀ tó àwọn tó kú, jẹ́ ibi tó gbẹ, tó sì ní ìyẹ̀pẹ̀ púpọ̀, tí kò sì ní àwọn ewéko púpọ̀.
Zulu: I-Jwaneng, eyayinesibalo esincane samakhizane, yayomile, inesihlabathi futhi inezitshalo ezincane.
Hausa: Jwaneng, wanda yake da mafi ƙarancin adadin kaska, ya kasance busasshen yashi kuma yana da ƙarancin ciyayi.
Northern Sotho: Jwaneng, ye e bego e na le palo ya fasana ya dikgofa, e be e omile, e na le santa ebile e se na sethokgwa.
Amharic: ይልቁንም ጅዋኔንግ ደረቅ፣አሸዋማ እና ያሉት እጽዋት አነስተኛ ሲሆን በጣም ጥቂት መዥገሮች አሉት ።

English: The researchers said veterinary records revealed a total of 42 cases of heartwater in Goodhope, 38 in Jwaneng, 75 in Kanye, and 146 in Moshupa, from 2017 to 2019.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebiwandiiko by’obulunzi byalaga nti waaliwo ensolo 42 ezaalina heartwater mu Goodhope, 38 mu Jwaneng, 75 mu Kanye, ne 146 mu Moshupa, okuva mu 2017 okutuuka mu 2019.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn oníṣèwòsàn ẹranko ṣàfihàn àwọn àìsàn tí ìdun fà jẹ́ 42 ní Goodhope, 38 ní Jwaneng, 75 ní Kanye àti 146 ní Moshupa, láti 2017 sí 2019.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi amarekhodi odokotela bezilwane aveze ukuthi angama-42 izibalo zesifo senhliziyo e-Goodhope, ama-38 e-Jwaneng, ama-75 e-Kanye, ayi-146 e-Moshupa, kusukela ngowezi-2017 kuya kowezi-2019.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce bayanan dabbobi sun nuna adadin 42 na cututtukan kumburin zuciya a Goodhope, 38 a Jwaneng, 75 a Kanye, da kuma 146 a Moshupa, daga shekarar 2017 zuwa shekarar 2019.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipego tša dingaka tša diphoofolo di utollotše palomoka ya malwetši a 42 a leruo go la Goodhope, 38 go la Jwaneng, 75 go la Kanye, le 146 go la Moshupa, go tloga ka 2017 go fihla ka 2019.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከ2017 እስከ 2019 ያሉት የእንስሳት ህክምና መዛግብት በጠቅላላው 42 በጉድሆፕ፣38 በጅዋኔንግ፣75 በካንዬ እና በሞሹፓ 146 የልብ ውሃ ህመም ክስተቶችን አሳይተዋል ብለዋል።

English: The researchers said heartwater affected local goats and cattle breeds more than breeds from other countries.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti obulwadde bwa heartwater bwakosa embuzi n’ente zinnansangwa okusinga ebika ebiva mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àìsàn tí ń mú àwọn ẹranko tí ìdun bá jẹ mú àwọn ewúrẹ́ àti àwọn ẹran míràn, ju àwọn ẹran ti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó kù lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe isifo senhliziyo sathinta izimbuzi nezinkomo zakuleli ngaphezu kwezakwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce cutar kumburin zuciya ta shafi akuyoyi da shanun gida fiye da irin na wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore bolwetši bja leruo e amile mehuta ya dipudi le dikgomo tša tikologo go feta mehuta ya go tšwa dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: የልብ ውሃ ከሌላ ሃገር ከመጡት ዝርያዎች ይልቅ በአካባቢው የሚገኙትን የፍየል እና የከብት ዝርያዎች እንደሚያጠቃ ተመራማሪዎቹ ተናግረዋል።

English: They said farmers made some efforts to control ticks.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abalunzi balina kaweefube gwe baakola okulwanyisa enkwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn àgbẹ̀ míràn gbìyànjú láti ṣe ìṣàkóso àwọn ìdun náà.
Zulu: Bathe abalimi benza imizamo ethile yokulawula amakhizane.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce manoma sun yi wani ƙoƙari na shawo kan kaska.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore balemi ba tšere matsapa a mangwe go lwantšha dikgofa.
Amharic: ገበሬዎች መዥገሮችን ለመቆጣጠር መጠነኛ ጥረት እንዳደረጉ ተናግረዋል።

English: For example, 63% of farmers dipped the animals in pesticides (chemicals used to kill pests like ticks).
Luganda: Okugeza, ebitundu 63% eby’abalunzi bannyikanga ensolo mu ddagala eritta ebiwuka n’enkwa.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, 63% àwọn àgbẹ̀ náà ki àwọn ẹran ìsìn náà sínú ògùn apakòkòrò (àwọn kẹ́míkáàlì tí wọ́n fí ń pa àwọn kòkòrò bí ìdun).
Zulu: Isibonelo, ama-63% abalimi bacwilisa izilwane kwizibulala-zinambuzane (amakhemikhali asetshenziselwa ukubulala izinambuzane njengamakhizane).
Hausa: Alal misali, kashi 63% na manoma na tsoma dabbobin a cikin maganin kashe ƙwari (sinadaran da ake amfani da su don kashe ƙwari kamar kaska).
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, 63% tša balemi ba tipile leruo la bona ka dibolayadikgofa (dikhemikhale tše di šomišwago go bolaya dikhunkhwane tše bjalo ka dikgofa).
Amharic: ለምሳሌ 63% የሚሆኑት ገበሬዎች እንስሳቱን በጸረ ተባይ መድሃኒቶች (መዥገሮችን የመሳሰሉ ተባዮችን ለመግደል የሚያገለግሉ ኬሚካሎች) ውስጥ አጥልቀዋቸዋል።

English: About one third (30%) of the farmers applied grease to their animals to control the ticks, while others (7%) resorted to building new kraals.
Luganda: Ekitundu nga kimu kyakusatu (30%) eky’abalunzi baasiiga giriisi ku nsolo zaabwe okulwanyisa enkwa, so ng’abalala (7%) baazimbanga ebiraalo ebipya.
Yoruba: Bíi ìdamẹ́ta (30%) àwọn àgbẹ̀ náà ni wọ́n fi gírísì pa àwọn ẹran wọn lára láti ṣe ìtọ́jú àwọn ìdun ara wọn, nígbà tí àwọn tó kù (7%) gbìyànjú láti kọ́ ààyè tuntun fún wọn.
Zulu: Cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu (30%) yabalimi bagcoba imfuyo yabo ngamafutha ukuze balawule amakhizane, kanti abanye (7%) baphendukela ekwakheni izibaya ezintsha.
Hausa: Kusan kashi ɗaya bisa uku (30%) na manoman sun shafa man giris ga dabbobinsu don shawo kan kaska, yayin da wasu (7%) suka koma gina sababbin gidajen dabbobi.
Northern Sotho: Palo ya teetharong (30%) ya balemi ba tloditše kherisi go leruo la bona go bolaya dikgofa, mola ba bangwe (7%) ba phethile ka go aga mašaka a maswa.
Amharic: (30%) የሚሆኑት ገበሬዎች መዥገሮችን ለመቆጣጠር እንስሳቶቻቸው ላይ ግሪስ ሲጠቀሙ ሌሎች (7%) የሚሆኑት ደግሞ አዳዲስ ጎጆዎችን ገንብተዋል።

English: The researchers also found that 44% of farmers did not do anything to deal with a suspected sick animal, while 15% said they would visit veterinary officers for advice, but gave medicine to the animals themselves.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakizuula nti ebitundu 44% eby’abalunzi tebaalinanga kye bakola okutaasa ensolo eteeberezebwa okuba endwadde, so ng’ebitundu 15% baagamba nti baagendanga ew’omusawo w’ebisolo okubawa amagezi, naye ng’ensolo baazeeweeranga eddagala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún ri pé 44% àwọn àgbẹ̀ náà ò ṣe nǹkankan láti tọ́jú ẹran tí wọ́n ri pé ó dà wí pé ó fẹ́ rẹ̀, ti 15% àwọn àgbẹ̀ náà ní àwọn máa lọ sí ọ̀dọ̀ oníṣèwòsàn ẹranko fún ìmọ̀ràn, ṣùgbọ́n tí wọ́n padà fún ẹran náà lógùn fún ara wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi u-44% wabalimi abakaze benze lutho ukubhekana nesilwane okusolakala ukuthi siyagula, u-15% uthe uzoya kovakashela odokotela bezilwane ukuze bathole izeluleko, kodwa bazinikeze imithi ngokwabo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa kashi 44% na manoma ba sa yin wani abu don tunkarar dabbar da ake zargi da rashin lafiya, yayin da kashi 15% suka ce za su ziyarci jami’an kula da dabbobi domin neman shawara, amma sun ba wa dabbobin magunguna da kansu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše le gore 44% tša balemi ga se ba dira selo go hlakodiša leruo leo go bego go gononwa gore le a babja, mola 15% ba boletše gore ba ka etela dingaka tša malwetši a diphoofolo go hwetša maele, eupša ba file diruiwa dihlare ka bobona.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳገኙት 44% የሚሆኑት ገበሬዎች በበሽታ የተጠረጠረን እንስሳ ለመርዳት ምንም ነገር እንዳላደረጉ እና 15% ለምክር ወደ እንስሳት ሃኪም ቢሄዱም መድሃኒቱን ግን ለእንስሳቱ የሚሰጧቸው ራሳቸው ናቸው።

English: Even though there was a vaccine available to prevent heartwater disease, the researchers said 93% of the farmers did not use it.
Luganda: Newankubadde waaliwo eddagala erigema obulwadde bwa heartwater, abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebitundu 93% eby’abalunzi tebaalikozesanga.
Yoruba: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé àjẹsára wà láti dènà àwọn àìsàn tí ń mú àwọn ẹran látara ìdun, àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé 93% àwọn àgbẹ̀ náà ò lò ó.
Zulu: Yize wawukhona umgomo otholakalayo wokuvikela isifo senhliziyo, abacwaningi bathi u-93% wabalimi abazange bawusebenzise.
Hausa: Duk da cewa akwai maganin rigakafin kamuwa da cutar kumburin zuciya, masu binciken sun ce kashi 93% na manoma ba sa amfani da shi.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go be go na le moento wo o thibelago bolwetši bja leruo, banyakišiši ba boletše gore 93% tša balemi ga se ba o šomiša.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳ የልብ ውሀ በሽታን ለመከላከል የሚያስችል ክትባት ቢኖርም 93% የሚሆኑት ገበሬዎች እንዳልተጠቀሙበት ተመራማሪዎቹ ይናገራሉ።

English: Farmers told the researchers that it was because they were not educated about the vaccine, and because they could not afford the vaccine.
Luganda: Abalunzi baategeeza abanoonyereza nti kino kyali bwekityo kubanga baali tebasomeseddwa bikwata ku ddagala ligema, n’okubeera nga baali tebasobola kugula ddagala ligema.
Yoruba: Àwọn àgbẹ̀ sọ fún àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí náà pé nítorí kò sí ìlanlọ́yẹ̀ fún wọ́n nípa àjẹsára náà, àti pé owó wọn ò ká ríra àjẹsára náà.
Zulu: Abalimi batshele abacwaningi ukuthi yingoba abazange bafundiswe ngomgomo, nangenxa yokuthi babengakwazi ukuthenga umgomo.
Hausa: Manoman sun shaida wa masu binciken cewa saboda ba a wayar musu da kai game da maganin rigakafin ba, kuma saboda ba za su iya sayen allurar rigakafin ba.
Northern Sotho: Balemi ba boditše banyakišiši gore ke ka baka la gore ba se ba hwetša tlhahlo ka ga moento, le gore ba be ba hloka tšhelete ya go reka moento.
Amharic: ስለ ክትባቱ ትምህርት ባለማግኘታቸው እና ለክትባቱ የሚሆን ገንዘብ ስለሌላቸው እንደሆነ ገበሬዎቹ ለተመራማሪዎቹ ተናግረዋል።

English: Other studies in the past looked at how ticks were distributed in Africa, including Botswana, but according to the researchers, theirs was the first to look at the relationship between ticks and heartwater cases in Botswana.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okulala okwakolebwa emabega kwatunuulira engeri enkwa gye zaali zisaasaanyeemu mu Africa, omuli ne Botswana, naye okusinziira ku banoonyereza bano, okunoonyereza kwabwe kwe kwali kusoose okutunuulira akakwate wakati w’enkwa n’obulwadde bwa heartwater mu Botswana.
Yoruba: Àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ti tẹ́lẹ̀ kán wo bí àwọn ìdun ṣe pín sí ní Africa, tí Botswana jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára wọn, ṣùgbọ́n gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣe sọ, ti wọn ló kọ́kọ́ ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò ìbáṣepọ̀ tí ó wà láàárín ìdun àti àwọn àìsàn tí àwọn ẹran ìsìn ń ní látara ìdun ní Botswana.
Zulu: Olunye ucwaningo olwedlule lubheka ukuthi amakhizane asatshalaliswa kanjani e-Afrika, okuhlanganisa ne-Botswana, kodwa ngokwabacwaningi, olwabo yilo olwaqala ukubheka ubudlelwano phakathi kwamakhizane nesifo senhliziyo  e-Botswana.
Hausa: Sauran nazarin da aka yi a baya sun yi nazari a kan yadda ake rarraba kaska a Afirka, ciki har da ƙasar Botswana, amma a cewar masu binciken, nasu ne ya fara duba alaƙar da take tsakanin kaska da cutar kumburin zuciya a ƙasar Botswana.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše dingwe tše di fetilego di lebeletše ka moo dikgofa di bego di phatlaletše ka gona ka Afrika, go akaretša Botswana, eupša go ya ka banyakišiši, tša bona e bile tša mathomo go lebelela kamano magareng ga dikgofa le malwetši a leruo ka Botswana.
Amharic: ቦትስዋናን ጨምሮ በአፍሪካ መዥገሮች እንዴት እንደተሰራጩ ቀደምት ጥናቶች የተመለከቱ ቢሆንም እንደ ተመራማሪዎቹ አስተሳሰብ፣ በቦትስዋና ውስጥ በመዥገሮች እና በልብ ውሃ ጉዳይ መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት የተመለከተው ጥናታቸው በአይነቱ የመጀመሪያው ነው።

English: They said the cases of heartwater recorded by veterinary doctors might actually be less than the actual cases experienced by farmers, because veterinary doctors usually only test for heartwater disease when an animal has died, meaning that animals living with the disease or animals that recovered are not always counted.
Luganda: Baagamba nti omuwendo gw’ensolo endwadde za heartwater ezaali ziwandiikiddwa abasawo b’ebisolo guyinza okuba nga guli wansi w’omuwendo gwennyini oguli mu balunzi, kubanga abasawo b’ebisolo batera kukebera obulwadde bwa heartwater ng’ensolo efudde, ekitegeeza nti ensolo ezibeerawo n’obulwadde oba ensolo ezaawona tezitera kubalibwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn àìsàn tí àwọn ẹran ìsìn ní látara ìdun tí àwọn oníṣèwòsàn ẹranko kọ sílẹ̀ lè kéré ju èyí tí àwọn àgbẹ̀ náà ti rí lọ, nítorí àwọn oníṣèwòsàn ẹranko máa ń sábà ṣe àyẹ̀wò fún irúfẹ́ àìsàn tí ìdun ń fà yìí nígbà tí ẹran náà bá ti kú, ní èyí tó túmọ̀ sí pé wọn kìí ka àwọn ẹran ìsìn tí wọ́n ṣì wà láàyè tí wọ́n ní àìsàn yìí tàbí àwọn tí ara wọn ṣẹ̀ ń yá.
Zulu: Bathe izibalo zenhliziyo eziqoshwa ngodokotela bezilwane kungenzeka abe mancane kunezimo zangempela ezitholwa abalimi, ngoba odokotela bezilwane bavame ukuhlola isifo senhliziyo kuphela lapho isilwane sesifile, okusho ukuthi izilwane ezinalesi sifo noma izilwane ezilulamayo azijwayelekile njalo kubalwa.
Hausa: Haka nan kuma sun ce lamarin cutar kumburin zuciya da likitocin dabbobi suke rubutawa na iya zama ƙasa da na ainihin cutar da manoma ke fuskanta, domin likitocin dabbobi kan yi gwajin cutar kumburin zuciya ne kawai idan dabba ta mutu, ma’ana ba ko yaushe ake ƙidaya dabbobin da suke ɗauke da cutar ko dabbobin da suka warke.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore malwetši a leruo ao a begilwego ke dingaka tša diphoofolo a ka ba a fetwa ke malwetši ao balemi ba itemogelago ona, ka gore dingaka tša diphoofolo gantši di dira diteko tša bolwetši bja leruo ge seruiwa se hwile, se se šupago gore diruiwa tše di nago le bolwetši bjo goba diruiwa tše di phologilego ga di ke di balwa.
Amharic: በእንስሳት ዶክተሮች የተመዘገበው የልብ ውሃ ክስተት ገበሬዎች ካጋጠማቸው ትክክለኛ ክስተት በእርግጥ ሊያንስ ይችላል፤ ምክንያቱም አብዛኛውን ጊዜ የእንስሳት ዶክተሮች እንስሳው የልብ ውሃ በሽታ እንዳለበት የሚመረምሩት ሲሞት ብቻ ነው፤ ይህም ማለት ከበሽታው ጋር የሚኖሩ እና ከበሽታው ያገገሙ እንስሳት ሁልጊዜም አይቆጠሩም።

English: The researchers recommended that farmers should be educated on how to control and manage heartwater disease in their livestock, so as to reduce its burden in the area.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateesa nti abalunzi basaanye okusomesebwa ku ngeri y’okulwanyisaamu n’okukwatamu obulwadde bwa heartwater mu nsolo zaabwe, okusobola okukendeeza ku bulabe bwabwo mu kitundu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí gbà wọ́n níyànjú pé kí wọ́n la àwọn àgbẹ̀ náà lọ́yè lórí bí wọ́n ṣe lè ṣàkóso àti ṣe ìtọ́jú àwọn àìsàn tí ẹran ìsìn wọ́n ní nípa ìdun, láti lè dín wàhálà náà kù ní àgbègbè náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bancome ukuthi abalimi kumele bafundiswe ukuthi bangasilawula kanjani futhi balawule isifo senhliziyo emfuyweni yabo, ukuze kwehliswe umthwalo waso endaweni.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa a ilimantar da manoma a kan yadda za su shawo kan cutar kumburin zuciya a dabbobinsu, ta yadda za a rage musu nauyin yawaitarsu a yankin.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišintše gore balemi ba swanetše go fiwa tlhahlo mabapi le ka moo go ka laolwago le go lwantšha bolwetši bja leruo go maruo a bona, gore go fokotšwe bothata bjo ka tikologong.
Amharic: ገበሬዎች በአካባቢያቸው ያለውን ጫና ለመቀነስ ይችሉ ዘንድ በከብቶቻቸው ውስጥ የልብ ውሃ በሽታን እንዴት መቆጣጠር እና መቋቋም እንዳለባቸው ትምህርት ሊሰጣቸው እንደሚገባ ተመራማሪዎቹ አሳስበዋል።

English: They also said more research should be done to determine factors that lead to the thriving of ticks.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti okunoonyereza okulala kusaanye okukolebwa okuzuula ensonga ezisobozesa enkwa okubeerawo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé kí wọ́n tẹ̀síwájú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí láti lè mọ àwọn okùnfà ìdàgbàsókè àwọn ìdun náà.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi kumele kwenziwe olunye ucwaningo ukuze kubhekwe izinto eziholela ekutheni imikhaza ichume.
Hausa: Haka nan sun kuma ce ya kamata a ƙara yin bincike domin gano abubuwan da suke haifar da bunƙasuwar kaska.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše le gore go swanetše go dirwa dinyakišišo tše ntši go utolla dintlha tšeo di bakago go ntšifala ga dikgofa.
Amharic: መዥገሮቹ እንዲያድጉ የሚያደርጓቸውን ምክንያቶች ለመወሰን ተጨማሪ ጥናት ሊደረግ እንደሚገባም ተናግረዋል።

English: The researchers were based in Botswana.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baali bava mu Botswana.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ń gbé ní Botswana.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebezinze e-Botswana.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kasance a ƙasar Botswana.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba etšwa ka Botswana.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የተመሰረቱት ቦትስዋና ላይ ነበር።
